text.title: RACI AI Assisted Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from a named trigger to a published `RACIMatrix` and its quarterly review: confirm the trigger and snapshot roster and open leaves, scaffold one row per open leaf, assign a single anchored A per row, fill R / C / I with one column per role, apply the roster-delta diff before the deadline, validate, publish with the notification record, and review within 90 days. Each step names the rule it satisfies and the fields of `02-output-contract.xml` it fills.

step.name: confirm-the-trigger-and-snapshot-the-inputs
step.input: The event that fired (kickoff, a roster join / leave / role change, or the quarterly date); the WBS spec from [[wbs-creation]]; the team roster; the project charter; the prior `RACIMatrix` if one exists.
step.action: Set `header.trigger` to the enum value that matches the event. Copy the roster's role ids and people into `roster`, and the ids of every WBS leaf that is open into `wbs_open_leaves`. Set `header.status: draft` (r-trigger-enum-and-roster-delta).
step.decision-gate: No WBS spec or no roster with role ids: stop, build those first. Event not in the enum ("when needed", "someone asked"): refuse; no refresh without a named trigger.

step.name: scaffold-one-row-per-open-leaf
step.action: Run `raci-scaffold` (`templates/skeleton.md.j2`): one row per id in `wbs_open_leaves`, never a row for a parent node. Carry forward a prior row's A only when that role is still in `roster` and the leaf is still open; otherwise leave the cell empty. Keep a prior row whose leaf has closed, marked for removal at the next quarterly review (r-rows-bind-to-wbs-leaves).
step.output: `rows[]` with `wbs_id` and `deliverable`, R / A / C / I empty or carried forward.

step.name: assign-a-single-anchored-accountable
step.input: Scaffolded rows, the charter, the WBS dictionary, the stakeholder register.
step.action: Run `raci-assign-A`. For each row pick exactly one role id from `roster` as `accountable` and record the anchor that justifies it in `evidence` as `charter#section`, `wbs-dict#wbs_id` or `stakeholders#row`; set `status: anchored`. Where no source justifies an A, still name the model's best candidate but set `status: proposed` with `evidence: []` and route the row to the PM (r-exactly-one-accountable-per-row, r-evidence-anchor-per-assignment).
step.output: Every row with one `accountable`, its `evidence` and `status`.
step.decision-gate: Any row where the model wants two names, "team" or "tbd": the row is `proposed`, not published, until the PM names one role.

step.name: fill-responsible-consulted-informed
step.input: Rows with A assigned, the roster, the charter.
step.action: Put at least one role in `responsible`. Put in `consulted` only roles asked before the deliverable is decided; roles that only need the outcome go in `informed`. Never list a role in two columns of one row. Where the C list is longer than the R list, send the row to the PM and record the decision as `over_consultation_reviewed: true` or trim the list (r-responsible-in-roster, r-one-column-per-role-per-row).

step.name: apply-the-roster-delta
step.input: The join / leave / role-change notice with the person, the role id and the effective date; the current rows.
step.action: Only when `header.trigger` is `roster_delta`. Fill `roster_delta` with `change`, `role`, `person`, `effective_date` and `refresh_deadline` (the last day for a leave or role change, `effective_date` + 7 days for a join). Mark every row that names the departed role `orphaned`, reassign each with a new anchor, and list `rows_changed`, `rows_orphaned` (still unresolved) and `rows_reassigned` with their anchors (r-trigger-enum-and-roster-delta, r-responsible-in-roster).
step.output: `roster_delta` complete; no row still names a role outside `roster`.
step.decision-gate: `refresh_deadline` already passed or a row still `orphaned`: escalate to the PM the same day; the matrix stays draft.

step.name: validate-the-draft
step.action: Run `raci-validate`: `python3 scripts/validate-raci-ai-assisted.py --file matrix.json`. It checks one row per open leaf and no summary-node rows, every role in `roster`, exactly one A per row, one column per role, anchors on anchored rows, the delta deadline and the notification coverage (all eight rules).
step.output: `OK`, or a VIOLATION list with the rule id per line.
step.decision-gate: Any violation, or any row still `proposed` or `orphaned`: the PM resolves it; `header.status` stays `draft` and nothing is sent.

step.name: publish-and-notify-every-r-and-a-holder
step.input: A validated draft with every row `anchored`; the team channel.
step.action: Set `header.status: published`, `header.last_reviewed` to today, bump `header.version`. Send each person holding an R or A their rows in the team channel and append a `review_log` entry with `kind: publish` and `notification.channel`, `sent_on` and `recipients[]` (role, person, rows). Re-run the validator; commit (r-notify-assignees-on-publish).

step.name: quarterly-review-within-90-days
step.input: The published matrix, the current WBS spec and roster, `scripts/staleness-check.py` output (weekly cron).
step.action: Before `last_reviewed` is 90 days old, run with `header.trigger: quarterly_review`: remove rows whose leaf is closed, re-run steps 2-6 against the current roster, resolve rows still `proposed`, bump `version`, and append a `review_log` entry with `kind: quarterly_review`, `rows_removed`, `rows_reassigned` and `rows_still_proposed`; then publish per step 7 (r-quarterly-review-90-days).
step.output: Refreshed, published matrix; `review_log` with the review counts.
step.decision-gate: `rows_still_proposed` unchanged for two consecutive reviews: the PM decides those rows in the review meeting, not the next one.

list.item: `header.trigger` is `kickoff`, `roster_delta` or `quarterly_review`; a `roster_delta` carries its diff and `last_reviewed` is on or before `refresh_deadline`.
One row per open WBS leaf, no summary-node rows, every R / A / C / I value in `roster`, one column per role per row.
Every row has exactly one `accountable`, at least one anchor and `status: anchored`; `header.status: published`.
Latest `review_log` publish entry names channel, date and the rows sent to every R / A holder; `last_reviewed` is within 90 days.
